ios.desc:
Stand Out by Creating Your Own Wallpapers!

Wally is a unique app that harnesses the power of AI to deliver stunning, one-of-a-kind wallpapers, enabling you to create your next wallpaper in seconds!
In a world where personalization is key, Wally offers an effortless way to transform your device with unique backgrounds that stand out.

=== HOW WALLY WORKS ===

• Choose Your Subject: Start by selecting a subject for your wallpaper – anything from animals to abstract art.
• Pick Your Style: Next, choose an artistic style, such as photographic, neon-punk, anime, fantasy...
• Customize Colors: Optionally, add up to three color tints to make your wallpaper even more personalized.
• Generate with AI: Press a button and let Wally's AI do the magic, creating a unique wallpaper in seconds.
• Save or Share: Instantly save your new wallpaper to your photo library or share it with friends on social media.
• Repeat & Enjoy: Create as many wallpapers as you like, experimenting with different combinations for endless creativity.

=== WALLY FEATURES ===

• Create Unique Wallpapers: Select your subject, style, and color tints for custom creations.
• AI-Driven: Unique wallpapers crafted by advanced Artificial Intelligence model, tailored to your preferences.
• Share with friends: Share your custom wallpapers easily on social media.
• Diverse Artistic Styles: Choose from a wide range of artistic styles, from neon punk to digital art.
• Save to Photo Library: Seamlessly save your creations directly to your device.
• User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive and easy to navigate for quick wallpaper creation.

=== WHY SHOULD YOU USE WALLY ===

• Simplicity and Efficiency: Wally's user-friendly design makes creating wallpapers quick and hassle-free.
• Endless Creations: Powered by AI, each new generation is unique, the possibilities for new wallpapers are limitless.
• Share Your Creativity: Easily share your custom wallpapers, inspiring your friends and standing out on social media.
• High-Quality Wallpapers: Enjoy high-resolution wallpapers that look stunning on your device.
• Stay Fresh and Trendy: Regular updates with new themes and styles keep your wallpaper collection modern and trendy.

Our app is FREE to use. However, you can support us with in-app purchases that grants you a Premium status.
Prices may differ based on your country and currency.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone,

I'm Adrien, an indie iOS developer passionate about creating user-friendly, easy-to-use applications. I'm super excited to introduce you to my latest creation: Wally: Create your Wallpapers !

- Wally's Concept -
Wallpapers add a personal touch to our phones. 
Often, we settle for what's easily available on apps or web, but why not make something truly your own? That's where Wally comes in. 
It's a straightforward app that lets you create your own unique wallpapers using AI – no skills needed. Every wallpaper you make is unique and exclusively yours.

I've designed Wally to be as user-friendly as possible, just like my previous apps. 
Creating a new wallpaper is so easy, just follow these three simple steps:

1. Choose a Subject: The subject is the central element of your wallpaper. A list of pre-defined subjects is available, with new ones added regularly.

2. Choose a Style: Guide the AI to achieve your desired result by selecting a style from our list.

3. Choose Color Tints (Optional): You can pick up to three color tints to influence the AI, leading to surprising outcomes. Or, leave the choice to the AI, based on your selected subject and style.

Then, all you need to do is press a button and... voilà! 
Your new wallpaper is generated in an instant. 
The whole process takes just a few seconds. 
Keep in mind, though, that the results might vary depending on the chosen subject and style, since we're working with the creativity of AI.
